title: The hub's connection to its observability platform
description: docs/estate/observability.json. /connect-observability-platform writes it, and a hub without it collects nothing. It names the observability platform, its URL and the hub's id, and holds no credential: with auth bearer, the default, each laptop sets HARNESS_OBSERVABILITY_TOKEN. scripts/observability/config.mjs checks the same rules.

hub.description: The hub's id, the same on every laptop. Each record carries it.

platform.description: The observability platform: CubeAPM, through its JSON-lines endpoint, or Grafana, through the push endpoint of its Loki collector behind an authenticating proxy.

url.description: The observability platform's own base URL, over https, or over http to a local instance on this laptop. It must not carry a user name or a password.

auth.description: How the sender authorises its requests: bearer sends each laptop's HARNESS_OBSERVABILITY_TOKEN, and none sends no authorisation, for a receiver that needs no key.
